decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter builds directly on the firm's core salami know-how, so it fits existing knowledge, but its mere mention on the website suggests weaker commitment and a higher risk of being pruned from a crowded chilled-meat range.
Organic poultry mini salami snacks extend existing snack-salami capabilities into a growing segment, and the dedicated page shows management sees value it can learn from and refine.

The premium sharing salami snack leverages the firm's established production and market knowledge most closely, and its own product page signals active promotion, making early discontinuation unlikely.
